description: Girth: record skill use in the local ledger (~/.girth/ledger.jsonl); with Claude Code 2.1.287+, the girth.js mod adds Lens (per-project skill, MCP and tool listings), Meter (per-turn token usage and outcomes: test verdicts, commits, PRs), the cache doctor, the keeper (keeps the prompt cache warm while idle), and opt-in idle compaction and subagent model. Never blocks or fails the session.
